ControlDescription: Remote access to a system processing classified information from an off-site or unclassified location is strictly prohibited.
ControlSupplementalText: Unencrypted remote access, commercial VPNs, and split-tunneling are forbidden.

ControlDescription: Audit record generation capabilities cannot be bypassed or turned off by privileged system administrators without triggering an immediate high-priority security alert.
ControlSupplementalText: Auditable events must capture all classification level changes, cross-boundary file transfers, print jobs containing classified markings, failed login attempts, privilege escalations, and media writing operations.
